summary: One update command: `update` refreshes the Composer deployer before the stack; `update self` refreshes only the deployer.
highlights: Wrapper 5: `./start.sh update` with no named services pulls the deployer first, so the stack and resident pair update on the new Composer.
`./start.sh update self` updates only the deployer; naming services keeps the deployer as is.
`self update` stays as a deprecated alias with a note pointing to `update self`.
